notes.title: Eternal Sacrifice moves straight into launching the full release
notes.notes:
Greetings 'Eternal Sacrifice' Community!

We're here with a game-changing update! Instead of releasing a prologue, we're jumping straight into launching the full version of 'Eternal Sacrifice'!

Our initial plan was to introduce you to our game with a prologue. But, we thought, why not dive right into the full experience? So, we're going all in to give you an epic, complete experience from day one.
This means 'Eternal Sacrifice' will be launched as a paid game. This decision ensures we can deliver the best possible game to you.

Your support means everything to us, and we're eager to share more details soon. Stay tuned for the release date and other exciting news and updates!
